new_scholarship.description: The OAS-AUWCL Scholarship Program awards a 50% tuition waiver for the LL.M. programmes of American University Washington College of Law in Washington, D.C., under the OAS Partnerships Program for Education and Training (PAEC). It is open to citizens and permanent legal residents of any active OAS member state other than the United States who hold a JD from an ABA-accredited US law school or an equivalent foreign law degree and are admitted to an AUWCL LL.M. programme. Applicants apply for admission through AUWCL, which then issues the Admissions Letter used for scholarship consideration; the Spring 2027 deadlines are 1 November 2026 for residential study and 30 November 2026 for hybrid and online study. The award covers 50% of published tuition; recipients pay the remaining tuition, mandatory fees, health insurance, books, graduation and visa costs, travel, and all other living and study costs, and must commit to return to work in their sponsoring country for the duration of the scholarship.

new_scholarship.description: The Organization of American States General Secretariat, together with Universidad Internacional de La Rioja (UNIR, Spain), Escuela de Posgrado Newman (EP Newman, Peru) and UNIR Mexico, offers up to 885 tuition scholarships through the OAS Partnerships Program for Education and Training for online postgraduate and first-year undergraduate study. Awards are tuition discounts of 60% of total tuition for official master's degrees at all three institutions and for UNIR official bachelor's degrees, and 50% for UNIR permanent training programmes. Eligibility extends to nationals and permanent residents of any OAS member state except Nicaragua, who must be admitted to a listed programme and cannot study in their country of origin. For the second (Otoño 2026) call, applications close on 19 October 2026 for UNIR and EP Newman programmes, 26 October 2026 for UNIR Mexico master's degrees and 30 October 2026 for UNIR permanent training programmes. Recipients pay the remaining tuition plus admission fees, translation, study materials and graduation costs, and must maintain an average grade of 5/10 or higher.

programme_detail_official.description: COMEXUS, the U.S.-Mexico Commission for Educational and Cultural Exchange and the Fulbright Commission in Mexico, runs the Beca Posgrado STEM Regional as a regional variant of its Fulbright-Garcia Robles postgraduate scholarship. It is open from 2 September 2026 to 15 January 2027 for Mexican nationals who originate from and reside in the interior of Mexico, excluding Mexico City, Guadalajara, Monterrey and their metropolitan areas, who have an intermediate level of English and will study a STEM master's or doctorate in the United States beginning August 2028. The award pays up to USD 37,000 per academic year for master's study lasting up to 18 months and up to USD 25,000 per academic year for doctoral study lasting up to three years, and COMEXUS supports the admission process at up to five universities. Applicants who already hold a US university admission, hold US residence or nationality, or hold a conditional admission requiring an English course are excluded.

research_notes.logo: The only full wordmark on comexus.org.mx is https://www.comexus.org.mx/images/logo.svg. I fetched it and read the SVG source: every path carries class cls-1 with .cls-1{fill:#fff}, so it is a white-on-transparent wordmark intended for the site's dark header - explicitly banned by the brief. I then probed the site's own /favicon.ico, which returned HTTP 200 with content-type image/x-icon and 1,150 bytes, and webfetch confirmed 'Unsupported image format: image/x-icon'. That is the awarding body's own asset on its own registrable domain, so it is reported instead of the banned white mark. I tried /apple-touch-icon.png, /images/logo-dark.svg, /images/Logo.svg and /images/logotipo.svg; all returned HTTP 404. No third-party host, CDN or social-media asset was used.
